dataset_title: Roadside grass anaerobic digestion pilot and large-scale abstract-level evidence
source_title: From grass to gas and beyond: Anaerobic digestion as a key enabling technology for a residual grass biorefinery
license: No reuse license identified in accessible metadata; only factual abstract observations transcribed.
data_basis: Roadside grass; abstract reports a peak biogas yield up to 700 Nm3 per tonne DOM (DOM expansion not verified) and 49-55% methane content. It does not pair these across configurations.
applicability: Reference-only pilot/large-scale roadside grass AD evidence. The abstract does not establish that its feed is the GreenHub protein-depleted residual.
limitations: Peak yield and methane fraction are not configuration-paired; do not combine them to compute methane yield.
DOM denominator is preserved exactly as the source abbreviation because its expansion and mass basis are not verifiable from the abstract alone.
No residence time, organic loading rate, temperature, feed characterization, variance, gas normalization conditions or unit-level energy demand are reported in the abstract.
Qualitative clogging, poor mixing and acidification outcomes do not quantify downtime or kinetic inhibition parameters.
Article license was not identified; no full-text tables or figures are reproduced.
